# Decision Journal / 别纠结

Decision Journal is a local-first AI decision assistant that remembers: it accepts text, voice, and image input, organizes a choice into evidence, risks, and a next step, and keeps each decision in a local journal for later review and export. It does not make the final decision for the user.

## Canonical resources

- Repository: https://github.com/mianbaofang/decision-journal
- Chinese README: https://github.com/mianbaofang/decision-journal/blob/master/README.md
- English README: https://github.com/mianbaofang/decision-journal/blob/master/README.en.md
- Installable Skill entry: https://github.com/mianbaofang/decision-journal/blob/master/skills/decision-journal/SKILL.md
- Public release: https://github.com/mianbaofang/decision-journal/releases
- Chinese Pages intro: https://mianbaofang.github.io/decision-journal/
- English Pages intro: https://mianbaofang.github.io/decision-journal/index-en.html

Decision Journal is the public product and repository identity. `decision-journal` is the retained installable Skill and CLI identifier for package discovery and existing commands.

## Capabilities

- Rational analysis of benefits, risks, reversibility, values, and a smallest next step.
- Low-stakes random choice with optional visual effects.
- Nature and Traditional Culture lenses presented as perspective or entertainment, not professional advice.
- Guided dialogue, automatic lens selection, local SQLite decision journal, execution/regret tracking, and statistics.
- Export a single decision as Markdown or JSON (`.brief.md`) for archives, notes, or tooling.
- Optional OpenAI-compatible LLM, vision, Amap weather, Edge TTS, and browser speech input.

## Boundaries

This is decision support, not legal, medical, financial, psychological, employment, education, or relationship advice. A public repository, release, Pages page, or metadata file does not prove search indexing, ranking, downloads, or active users.

## Install

```bash
gh skill preview mianbaofang/decision-journal decision-journal
gh skill install mianbaofang/decision-journal decision-journal --agent codex --scope user
```
